pr_body:
Currently, json array macros are passing the outer "container" struct
to the Z_JSON_ELEMENT_DESCR macro, causing the alignment to be calculated
from the outer struct which may be incorrect. Fix this by using the
biggest shift from the nested objects to calculate the alignment as the
struct size is calculated based on the biggest alignment of it's members.

Also add a test for such case.
Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/73899

review_comments: Is it sufficient to just walk through this object, or do nested objects need to be traversed as well?

Should be sufficient, AFAIK the shifts for structs and whole arrays are calculated correctly and we can't have Z_JSON_ELEMENT_DESCR nested directly. I also did some more testing with nested arrays and structs and everything seems to work fine.
